title: layr change show <id> --json
description: One logical change: each version with its state and evidence, the behavior of the newest version, and the comments.

change_id.description: The full id of the change. The command also takes a unique prefix of it.

versions.description: The versions of the change, oldest first (v1, v2, ...).

behavior.description: The probe comparison of the newest version with its merge base on the target line (the line upstream, else main). A queue entry with stored probe results gives the comparison of the queue instead.

comments.description: The comments on the change, in the order they were recorded.

id.description: A layr id in UUID form.

time.description: A time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

actor.description: The user who recorded an operation on its machine.

uid.description: The user id (uid) on the machine of the record.

name.description: The user name on the machine of the record.

session.description: The LAYR_SESSION label of the process (a terminal, a CI job, an agent). Free text. Absent when it was not set.

version.description: The label of the version: 'v1' for the first. The revision 'changes/<change_id>/<label>' resolves to its state.

attestations.description: The attestations of the state, in the form of 'layr attestations --json'.

checks.description: The results of the check attestations of the state that are not revoked, in record order. A failed command is a result too (see 'exit').

kind.description: The kind of state: 'commit' (a named save), 'auto' (an automatic state), 'stash' (parked work), 'import' (from a git commit), 'cache' or 'derived' (data outside source history).

change_id.description: The id of the change of the state.

derived_from.description: For a derived state: the id of the state it was computed from.

context.description: For a derived state: the name of the computation, for example 'check-v1'.

parents.description: The ids of the parent states. Two or more for a merge.

line.description: The id of the line that made the state.

subvol.description: The id of the snapshot of the state on the machine that made it.

uid.description: The user id (uid) on the machine that made the state.

session.description: The LAYR_SESSION label of the process that made the state. Absent when it was not set.

message.description: The full message of the state.

running.description: True when the state was taken while processes ran in the line (crash-consistent only). Absent when false.

conflicts.description: The conflicts that the state holds. Absent when it has none.

layers.description: The cache snapshots of the state: the cache path to the snapshot name. Absent when there are none.

layer_by.description: The user id (uid) of the user who made the cache snapshots.

layer_shared.description: True when lines of other users may take the cache snapshots. Absent when false.

layer_platform.description: The platform of the cache snapshots, for example 'macos-aarch64'.

cache_key_parts.description: The parts of the cache key by name, each a short hash of its value.

parts.description: The part of the state on each overlay: the overlay name to the id of its state in the overlay store.

cache_of.description: For a cache snapshot: the id of the project state whose working folder it was taken with.

tree.description: The root tree of the state in the object store of the project, as 64 hex digits.

times.description: The id of the times table that goes with 'tree'.

conflict.description: One path with a merge conflict.

base.description: The id of the merge base state.

ours.description: The id of the state of the line in the merge.

theirs.description: The id of the state that was merged in.

attestation.description: One attestation. The schema 'attestations' describes the same object.

format.description: The format version of the attestation record.

id.description: The id of the state, or the id of the view.

change_id.description: The id of the change of the subject state.

payload_digest.description: The SHA-256 digest of the payload, as 64 lowercase hex digits.

payload_ref.description: Where the payload is kept, when it is kept apart from the record.

signer.description: Who signed the record: the id of a machine, or 'person:<login>' for a person key ('layr request').

check.description: The result of one check. 'layr try' writes command, argv, exit and seconds. A check of the check runner also writes name, state, privileged, executor, platform, log_ref, output_state, truncated, duration_ms and limits. A probe run also writes probe fields. A check attestation that 'layr attest check' made by hand has no result: its item is the record data (the 'attestation' member).

exit.description: The exit status of the command. 0 is a pass.

seconds.description: The run time in seconds ('layr try').

state.description: The id of the checked state.

privileged.description: True when the check ran as root.

executor.description: True when the check runner ran the check.

platform.description: The platform the check ran on.

log_ref.description: The ref of the derived state that holds the check log.

output_state.description: The id of the derived state that holds the output.

truncated.description: True when the log was cut at its size limit.

limits.description: The resource limits of the run.

attestation.description: The attestation, for a check attestation without a result.

operation.description: How the version was made. Absent for states that older layr versions made.

state.description: The id of the state of the version.

kind.description: The operation that made the version, for example 'amend', 'pick' or 'replay'.

source.description: The id of the state the operation started from.

target_line.description: The id of the line the operation wrote to. Null when there was none.

target_head.description: The id of the head of the target line before the operation.

id.description: The id of the operation record.

machine.description: The id of the machine that recorded the operation.

behavior.description: The probe comparison. 'probes' is empty when the project has no probes.

base.description: The id of the base state.

head.description: The id of the head state.

base_source.description: Whether the probe definitions of the base are available, for example 'available'.

head_source.description: Whether the probe definitions of the head are available, for example 'available'.

base_views.description: Saved views of the base with probe results, when the base state itself has none.

head_views.description: Saved views of the head with probe results, when the head state itself has none.

behavior_unavailable.description: The comparison could not be made, for example because the change and the target line have no common state.

base_run.description: For 'not run': true when the base has a result.

head_run.description: For 'not run': true when the head has a result.

base.description: The probe run of the base.

head.description: The probe run of the head.

exit_changed.description: True when the exit status of the probe changed.

changes.description: The changed outputs of the probe.

limit_reasons.description: For a screenshot probe: why a change is over its limit.

id.description: The id of the comment. 'layr comment --reply-to <id>' answers it.

version.description: The id of the state of the version that the comment is about.

path.description: The file the comment is about. Absent for a comment on the whole change.

reply_to.description: The id of the comment that this one answers.
